nodes.description: Public total token supply state variable declared in ERC20Basic/ERC20 and set in UBOToken constructor.
Boolean flag gating token transfers, toggled by enableTransfers and read by transfer/transferFrom.
Mapping(address=>uint256) of token balances in BasicToken, mutated by transfer, transferFrom and mint.
Nested mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint256)) allowance store in StandardToken.
Constant token name 'UBSexone' in UBOToken.
Constant token symbol 'UBO' in UBOToken.
Constant token decimals (0) in UBOToken.
Constant initial supply of 50,000,000 tokens with 0 decimals.
Cumulative ETH (wei) raised during the sale, incremented in buyTokens.
Cumulative tokens allocated during the sale, incremented in buyTokens.
Contract owner address, set from msg.sender in constructor and changed by changeOwner; target of ETH transfers.
Boolean sale-active flag toggled by startSale/stopSale and checked in buyTokens.
BasicToken.transfer(address,uint256) with onlyPayloadSize(2); moves balances and emits Transfer.
BasicToken.balanceOf(address) constant view returning balances[_owner].
StandardToken.transferFrom(address,address,uint256) with onlyPayloadSize(3); spends allowance and moves balances.
StandardToken.approve(address,uint256) sets allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
StandardToken.allowance(address,address) constant view on the allowed mapping.
StandardToken.increaseApproval(address,uint) adds to the caller's allowance using SafeMath.add.
StandardToken.decreaseApproval(address,uint) subtracts from allowance using SafeMath.sub, with a local oldValue.
UBOToken constructor initializing totalSupply, owner=msg.sender, balances[owner], tokenAllocated and transfersEnabled.
Payable fallback function that forwards control to buyTokens(msg.sender).
Payable token sale entry point; validates purchase, updates weiRaised/tokenAllocated, mints tokens and forwards ETH via wallet.transfer.
Computes token amount for a wei amount and reverts to 0 if it exceeds owner balance, emitting TokenLimitReached.
Internal pure function returning a fixed token amount based on the wei amount (commented-out tiers).
Internal mint helper moving tokens from the owner balance to a recipient and emitting Transfer.
onlyOwner function replacing the owner address and emitting OwnerChanged.
onlyOwner function setting saleToken = true.
onlyOwner function setting saleToken = false.
onlyOwner function setting transfersEnabled to the supplied boolean.
onlyOwner function sweeping the contract ETH balance via owner.transfer and the contract's token balance via transfer.
Caller-controlled msg.sender used for ownership, balance and allowance accounting.
External ETH send wallet.transfer(weiAmount) in buyTokens forwarding value to the owner address.
External ETH send owner.transfer(this.balance) sweeping the whole contract balance in claimTokens.
Internal token transfer(owner, balance) executed in claimTokens after the ETH sweep.
Address parameter _to of transfer.
uint256 parameter _value of transfer.
Address parameter _from of transferFrom.
Address parameter _to of transferFrom.
uint256 parameter _value of transferFrom.
Address parameter _spender of approve.
uint256 parameter _value of approve.
Address parameter _investor of buyTokens, the token recipient.
uint256 parameter _weiAmount of validPurchaseTokens.
uint256 parameter _weiAmount of getTotalAmountOfTokens.
Address parameter _to of mint, the mint recipient.
uint256 parameter _amount of mint.
Address parameter _owner of mint, the balance source.
Address parameter _newOwner of changeOwner.
bool parameter _transfersEnabled of enableTransfers.
Local address wallet = owner used as ETH transfer destination in buyTokens.
Local uint256 weiAmount = msg.value in buyTokens.
Local uint256 tokens returned by validPurchaseTokens in buyTokens.
Local uint256 addTokens computed by getTotalAmountOfTokens in validPurchaseTokens.
Local uint256 amountOfTokens initialised to 100 in getTotalAmountOfTokens.
Local uint256 balance = balanceOf(this) in claimTokens.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used to read and decrement the caller balance in transfer.
msg.sender indexes the allowed mapping and reads balances[_from] in transferFrom.
msg.sender is the owner key written in allowed[msg.sender][_spender] in approve.
owner is assigned from msg.sender inside the UBOToken constructor.
fallback forwards msg.sender as the _investor argument to buyTokens.
changeOwner is guarded by onlyOwner checking msg.sender == owner.
startSale is guarded by onlyOwner checking msg.sender == owner.
stopSale is guarded by onlyOwner checking msg.sender == owner.
enableTransfers is guarded by onlyOwner checking msg.sender == owner.
claimTokens is guarded by onlyOwner checking msg.sender == owner before sweeping funds.
transfer mutates balances[msg.sender] and balances[_to].
transfer requires transfersEnabled to be true.
transferFrom mutates balances[_from] and balances[_to].
transferFrom reads and decrements allowed[_from][msg.sender].
transferFrom requires transfersEnabled to be true.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
allowance reads allowed[_owner][_spender].
increaseApproval adds to allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
decreaseApproval reads and writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
balanceOf returns balances[_owner].
constructor sets totalSupply = INITIAL_SUPPLY.
constructor credits balances[owner] with INITIAL_SUPPLY.
constructor assigns owner = msg.sender.
constructor initialises tokenAllocated = 0.
constructor sets transfersEnabled = true.
buyTokens accumulates weiRaised with SafeMath.add.
buyTokens accumulates tokenAllocated with SafeMath.add.
buyTokens reads owner into wallet and uses owner in mint and validation.
buyTokens requires saleToken == true.
validPurchaseTokens emits TokenLimitReached with tokenAllocated.
validPurchaseTokens compares requested tokens to balances[owner].
validPurchaseTokens reads balances[owner] to cap the sale.
mint adds to balances[_to] and subtracts from balances[_owner].
changeOwner overwrites the owner state variable.
startSale sets saleToken = true.
stopSale sets saleToken = false.
enableTransfers sets transfersEnabled to the supplied value.
claimTokens reads owner for the ETH and token sweep destinations.
The payable fallback function invokes buyTokens(msg.sender).
buyTokens calls validPurchaseTokens(weiAmount) to size the purchase.
validPurchaseTokens calls getTotalAmountOfTokens(_weiAmount).
buyTokens calls mint(_investor, tokens, owner) after validation.
buyTokens performs the external ETH send wallet.transfer(weiAmount) to the owner address.
claimTokens performs the external ETH send owner.transfer(this.balance) sweeping the contract balance.
claimTokens performs a token transfer to owner after the external ETH send.
Parameter _to is the destination address consumed by transfer.
Parameter _value is the amount consumed by transfer.
Parameter _from is the source address consumed by transferFrom.
Parameter _to is the destination address consumed by transferFrom.
Parameter _value is the amount consumed by transferFrom.
Parameter _spender is the spender key used by approve.
Parameter _value is the allowance amount set by approve.
Parameter _investor is the beneficiary consumed by buyTokens.
buyTokens forwards _investor as the recipient of mint.
Parameter _weiAmount is the purchase amount consumed by validPurchaseTokens.
Parameter _weiAmount is consumed by getTotalAmountOfTokens.
Parameter _to is the recipient address consumed by mint.
Parameter _amount is the minted quantity consumed by mint.
Parameter _owner is the source balance address consumed by mint.
Parameter _newOwner is the new owner address consumed by changeOwner.
Parameter _transfersEnabled is the flag consumed by enableTransfers.
Local wallet copies owner and is the destination of the external ETH send.
Local weiAmount captures msg.value used for the sale accounting.
Local tokens holds the purchase result used for accounting and events.
Local tokens is passed as _amount into mint.
Local addTokens holds the computed token amount returned by validPurchaseTokens.
Local amountOfTokens is initialised and returned by getTotalAmountOfTokens.
Local balance holds balanceOf(this) swept by claimTokens.
